description:
generate: write the script from the brief and the narrative style;
each run is a new version (review it with script_read).

analyze (Analyze Script): find the script's characters, environments
and objects (including any named only in `[SCENE: ...]` directions) and
split it into voice blocks. Existing assets are kept as they are
(description, reference image, voice) and new ones added; assets the
script no longer names stay until the user deletes them. Review with
assets_read.

action.description: generate: write the script; analyze: Analyze Script

editable_sections.description: Template prompt section overrides, keyed by section id

model.description: Model id (get_generation_options); omit for the saved choice

settings.description: Model settings: keys of its settings_schema

name: script_generate
title: Generate the script or analyze it
